result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: an abruptly clipped carousel card in 'Fastest near you', inconsistent wishlist heart styling in 'Popular right now', and an implausible '-100%' promo badge.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row is abruptly clipped at the right screen edge - the '20-30 min' pill is cut off and the name shows as 'Trattoria Piccol' mid-word without ellipsis or padding
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal list end-padding, item spacing and text ellipsis so cards scroll fully into view instead of appearing truncated mid-element

issues.description: Wishlist heart buttons in 'Popular right now' have inconsistent styling - the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a white outline with no background scrim while the pizza card below shows a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent button style with a dark circular scrim/background for all wishlist icons to ensure visibility and visual consistency

issues.description: Second 'Popular right now' card shows a '-100%' badge which looks like a placeholder or data error and implies a free item
issues.suggestion: Verify promotion feed logic and replace with a valid discount label or remove the badge if no promotion applies
